technologyStack.backend: ASP.NET Core Web API 7.0, MediatR, CQRS, C#

architectureAndDesignPatterns: Clean Architecture with 4 concentric layers (Domain -> Application -> Infrastructure -> Api)
CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) pattern utilizing MediatR requests and notifications
Repository / DbContext pattern for persistent storage isolation in Infrastructure
Angular Standalone Component architecture with inject()-based dependency injection and Signal/RxJS state flows
solidPrinciples: Single Responsibility: Separate Command Handlers, Query Handlers, and Validators into distinct classes
Open/Closed: Extend pipeline behaviors (logging, validation, performance) via MediatR IPipelineBehavior rather than modifying handlers
Liskov Substitution: Ensure mockable repository and domain service abstractions behave predictably
Interface Segregation: Small, focused interfaces (e.g. IApplicationDbContext, IDateTimeProvider, ICurrentUserService)
Dependency Inversion: High-level application modules depend on interfaces defined in Application/Domain, implemented in Infrastructure
cleanCodeStandards: Use asynchronous operations (async/await, CancellationToken) through all controller-to-database call chains
Encapsulate domain invariants inside Domain Entities / Aggregates with private setters
Avoid primitive obsession by adopting Strongly Typed IDs and Value Objects where appropriate
Keep Angular components thin, delegating business logic and API interactions to dedicated TypeScript services
securityPractices: Sanitize and validate all incoming inputs using FluentValidation before passing to handlers
Use parameterized queries exclusively via EF Core / SQLite to prevent SQL injection
Enforce CORS policies strictly for the Angular client origin
Protect sensitive settings using ASP.NET Core User Secrets / Environment Variables, never committed to git
apiDesign: RESTful resource endpoints returning appropriate HTTP status codes (200 OK, 201 Created, 204 NoContent, 400 BadRequest, 404 NotFound, 500 InternalServerError)
OpenAPI / Swagger documentation with XML docs and ProducesResponseType attributes
Uniform JSON envelope / ProblemDetails (RFC 7807) for error responses
databasePractices: Configure EF Core SQLite provider with foreign key constraints enabled (PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON)
Use AsNoTracking() for all read-only Query handlers to optimize memory and query throughput
Maintain code-first EF Core migrations for schema versioning and deterministic updates
Define explicit indexes on foreign keys and frequently filtered columns
testingGuidelines: Unit testing for Domain Entities and Application Handlers using xUnit / NUnit and Moq/NSubstitute
Integration testing for API endpoints using WebApplicationFactory and SQLite in-memory / temporary DB
Frontend component and service testing with Vitest and Angular TestBed
antiPatternsToAvoid: Fat controllers: Controllers must only receive requests, forward to MediatR, and return action results
Direct DbContext usage inside API controllers or Angular services
Mixing Commands and Queries within a single MediatR handler
Subscribing inside Angular services without proper unsubscription / takeUntilDestroyed lifecycle handling
